name: Strait of Hormuz Crisis — 2026
description: US and Israel launch strikes on Iran February 28, assassinating Khamenei. Iran formally closes the Strait of Hormuz on March 4 — the first actual closure in history. 20% of global oil and LNG trade halts. A ceasefire is reached April 7 but the strait remains effectively closed through negotiations. Covers two weeks of pre-war calm, the outbreak, the closure, and the ceasefire/diplomacy phase.
